description: A plan that feels roughly right but has unresolved decisions routes to grilling, not brainstorming.
input: I have a plan for adding a background job queue to my app. It feels roughly right, but there are a few unresolved decisions still hiding in it — which skill should I use? There's no repo or thread for you to inspect — just tell me which skill fits.
rubric: PASS only if the reply names grilling as the skill to use for this situation. Mentioning brainstorming as a contrast (e.g. explaining that brainstorming is for when no plan exists yet, unlike this case) is fine and does not fail the case. FAIL if the reply recommends brainstorming, `/prep`, or some other skill as the primary fit instead of grilling, or does not name a skill at all.
